boundary: Runs inside an already ready DevPlayground. Checks the actual HUD and spawns one production network boss. No physical keyboard input, production scene transition, or production asset save is performed.

cases.name: Production HUD canvas and quick slots visible
cases.details: Active production HUD canvas, nonzero scale, health bar and both quick-slot hierarchies.

cases.name: Network boss owns exactly one health bar
cases.details: Real network boss spawned and owned one UI bar; lethal health change sent through production callback.

cases.name: Boss death removes its health bar
cases.details: Boss death callback completed and delayed bar was destroyed; spawned fixture despawned.

cases.name: Cleanup preserves saves and sandbox state
cases.details: Fixtures removed; original save context, enemy selection, god mode and cursor restored; save files/hash/timestamps and active scene unchanged.
